cases.name: Teresa Gail McDowell
cases.about:
Neighbors remember Teresa McDowell as a kind woman of faith, who loved yard sales. "I just knew that she was a very sweet lady. She loved to decorate for all the holidays. When she put up her decorations, I knew it was time to put up mine," said Casey Word.

Her obituary said, "Teresa was always present for events for her family. She didn't miss many opportunities to support people when they needed it. Her heart was as large as the Texas sky and her love language was gift-giving. She always had something for someone when she arrived and was willing to try to help anyone in need. When she was 17 years old, she started cleaning homes and working for her aunt and uncle who built houses in the Highland Lakes area. This strengthened her love for the job, so she decided to start a business built around her passion. Teresa built Professional Cleaning Services into an honest and dependable company with hundreds of clients in the Highland Lakes area, including being nominated multiple times as the best cleaning service in Burnet County. Teresa had a passion for plants and carried a large collection at her home. She also was very proud of her family, especially her grandchildren, with a very large collection of photographs."
